author: _Kiiro
body:
IGN: _Kiiro

The reason you were temp-banned/banned: FLY

Why you should be unbanned from the server?, I'm not saying I should be unbanned, I know now that I deserved those consequences because I was a noob at the time and didn't know hacking was bad. Know that I have matured, I realize that what I did was the dumbest decision of my life because I got banned from one of the best Pvping servers and now I love to PVP. I am truly sorry for what I did and hope that I can get a second chance.

Was my temp-ban or ban really false?:No


Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? yes
